name: com.pebblepouch.lore
description: Worldbuilding inside the Unity Editor: organize your game's lore in Categories, Entries and Fields, link Entries in descriptions, track integrity and content health, and read everything at runtime through a small API that can also change values while the game runs.

samples.description: One MonoBehaviour that uses a Lore Project at runtime: Categories, Entries, typed field values, field keys, descriptions, tags, and runtime changes with save/load.

A complete demo Lore Project: The Wonderful Wizard of Oz as the lore of a small game. Includes a playable scene (Oz Demo) that uses the Runtime API. Import it only into a project without a Lore Project of its own; delete the imported sample folder before you create your own.
